name: global_mean
description: Mean grayscale intensity across the full image.

name: local_difference_variability
description: Standard deviation of neighbouring horizontal and vertical differences.

name: dark_pixel_proportion
description: Proportion of pixels below the image mean minus one standard deviation.

name: bright_pixel_proportion
description: Proportion of pixels above the image mean plus one standard deviation.

name: laplacian_variance
description: Variance of the Laplacian response, representing high-frequency edge and texture variation.
